name: 现摘现发奶油草莓鲜果款
description: 现摘奶油草莓，颗颗饱满、酸甜多汁，多层保鲜锁鲜直达

styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft blush-pink #F9CDD3 panels for hero and infographic screens, clean white #FFFFFF photo cards inset on the pink panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused top light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows only, dewy fresh mood, no harsh speculars, food always looks juicy not plastic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pink-to-rose gradient backdrop and white ceramic plates on a soft plaid cloth for scene shots
styleLock.typography: modern rounded sans-serif headlines in deep plum #5C2530 or white #FFFFFF, headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded pill labels, single berry-red accent
styleLock.presentationRules: strawberries always shown plump and glossy with natural seeded skin texture, stable generous scale, no reshaping between shots; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh-fruit premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft blush-pink background #F9CDD3, clean white #FFFFFF, deep plum-brown text #5C2530 and one berry-red accent #D7294A; warm tone; soft diffused top light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows only, dewy fresh mood, never harsh speculars, fruit never looks plastic; modern rounded sans-serif headlines in deep plum #5C2530 or white #FFFFFF, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent rounded-corner cards and pill-shaped labels; clean appetizing food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, the product always shown plump and glossy with natural seeded skin texture; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.promptTemplate: Appetizing e-commerce hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}.
